channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Nvidia's board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, and the shares jump about 30%
item.description: Nvidia's board voted unanimously on November 23 to bring back Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director, days after his resignation.

item.title: GTA VI sold an estimated 44.9 million copies in its first four days
item.description: Alinea Analytics estimates GTA VI sold 44.9 million units and grossed over $4 billion by the end of its launch weekend.

item.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Sol to paid ChatGPT users
item.description: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6.2 Sol to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users, promising better instruction-following.

item.title: Sunrise on the Reaping opens to $120 million in the US and $225 million worldwide
item.description: The Hunger Games prequel opened to an estimated $120 million in North America and $225 million worldwide, AP reports.

item.title: SpaceX and Tesla reportedly name directors to negotiate a $3.5 trillion merger
item.description: SpaceX and Tesla have each named directors to negotiate a possible merger valued at $3.5 trillion, the Financial Times reports.

item.title: CIA and US intelligence office reportedly hit by breach of unclassified data
item.description: Some unclassified information at the CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence was breached, The New York Times reports.

item.title: Amazon agrees to buy Decart's AI optimisation technology and team
item.description: Amazon agreed to buy Decart's AI optimisation stack and bring in its team; TechCrunch reports the deal is worth $7.5 billion.

item.title: Anthropic posts a Claude-authored paper claiming a major result in complexity theory
item.description: Anthropic published a 70-page paper credited to Claude that claims VP is not equal to VNP, with a Lean formalisation; no human has checked it yet.

item.title: SpaceX is reportedly selling computing capacity to Anthropic and Google
item.description: SpaceX is selling computing capacity to AI rivals Anthropic and Google, The New York Times reports.

item.title: CD Projekt signs a Sony marketing deal for The Witcher 4
item.description: CD Projekt has signed a marketing deal with Sony for The Witcher 4, and compares its leap over Witcher 3 to GTA V to GTA VI.

item.title: Blade Runner 2099 arrives on Prime Video with all eight episodes on November 25
item.description: All eight episodes of Blade Runner 2099, starring Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer, stream on Prime Video from today, November 25.

item.title: US blacklists chip firm Megaspeed, and Malaysia orders data centres to cut it off
item.description: The US added Singapore's Megaspeed to its trade blacklist amid claims about Nvidia chip exports to China; Malaysia then ordered data centres to cut it off.

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship to help get code changes merged
item.description: Anthropic's Claude Ship beta adds PR Steward and Claude Approvals agents to help move pull requests through review on GitHub.

item.title: GTA VI ties Ocarina of Time with a 99 on Metacritic
item.description: GTA VI's reviews give it a Metacritic score of 99, level with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Shattered reports.

item.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie comes to Netflix on November 30
item.description: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie joins Netflix's US library on November 30 after its Peacock run, Collider reports.

item.title: Anthropic mathematician says Claude helped him prove the Riemann Hypothesis
item.description: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he proved the Riemann Hypothesis with help from Claude, Bloomberg reports.

item.title: OpenAI and Cisco release Shirudo, an open-source runtime for AI-written security patches
item.description: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, which loads temporary kernel protections on running Linux systems while real patches are prepared.

item.title: Azure API Management flaw used to steal secrets, Norway links it to energy firm attacks
item.description: Attackers abused a flaw in Azure API Management Classic tiers to read stored secrets and keys; Microsoft closed the path on November 19.

item.title: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok sexual deepfake images
item.description: Oregon and Virginia sued SpaceX and related companies, alleging Grok generated nonconsensual sexualised images, including of children.

item.title: The Hunt for Gollum reportedly casts Anya Taylor-Joy as an Elf
item.description: Anya Taylor-Joy will play an Elf named Seren in The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum, Collider reports.

item.title: Z.ai releases GLM-5.4 with a 1 million token context window
item.description: China's Z.ai released GLM-5.4, which it calls its first Loop Transformer flagship, with a 1 million token context and image support.

item.title: Deborah Ann Woll cast as Faye in Amazon's God of War series
item.description: Amazon MGM Studios says Deborah Ann Woll will play Faye, Kratos's late wife, in its live-action God of War series.

item.title: Netflix's The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth starts a two-week IMAX run
item.description: The Netflix film plays in IMAX cinemas from November 25 for two weeks before it premieres on the service on December 23.

item.title: SNL sets Seyfried, De Niro and Chalamet as December hosts
item.description: SNL confirmed Amanda Seyfried on December 5, Robert De Niro on December 12 and Timothee Chalamet on December 19.

item.title: Disney's animated Hexed leads the Thanksgiving week cinema openings
item.description: Disney's Hexed opens wide on November 25, alongside Hershey, Bitter Christmas and A24's Club Kid, with Focker In-Law following on November 27.

item.title: Broadcom patches another critical vCenter flaw after a recent zero-day
item.description: Broadcom fixed 23 VMware flaws, including a 9.8-rated authentication bypass in vCenter's directory service, CVE-2026-123903.

item.title: Meta launches its Muse AI agent in the UK
item.description: Meta's personal AI agent, Muse, is now available to UK adults on mobile, web and WhatsApp, and can keep working after the app closes.

item.title: Switch 2 Mario Kart World bundle drops to $499 for Black Friday
item.description: Amazon and Walmart are selling the Switch 2 with Mario Kart World for $499, $50 below its $549 price, for a limited time.

item.title: Cisco Expressway flaw exploited to break into internal networks
item.description: Attackers used a critical Cisco Expressway flaw, CVE-2026-76466, to get root access on devices and move into internal networks, Help Net Security reports.

item.title: Amazon delivery drone crashes into a Michigan garage, and the FAA is investigating
item.description: An Amazon delivery drone crashed into a garage in Michigan, and the Federal Aviation Administration is investigating, CNBC reports.

item.title: Nioh 3 is coming to Xbox Series X|S on January 28
item.description: Nioh 3 and its Complete Edition launch on Xbox Series X|S on January 28, 2027, with the Bloody Insurrection DLC on December 17.

item.title: DeepMind agents find faster quantum algorithms for fusion research
item.description: Google DeepMind says its AI agents improved quantum algorithms for fusion research, cutting estimated computing costs by 11.8 times.

item.title: Stevie Wonder jokes about blindness rumours at his Chicago show
item.description: At a November 21 concert in Chicago, Stevie Wonder answered the online theory that he is not really blind by inviting fans to get in the car with him.

item.title: GTA VI's first big patch, 1.002.002, comes with seven official fixes
item.description: Rockstar's update 1.002.002 is live on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and reports now list seven official fixes after it launched with no notes.

item.title: HPE's quarterly revenue rises 50% to $14.5 billion
item.description: Hewlett Packard Enterprise reported fourth-quarter revenue of $14.5 billion, up 50% from a year earlier, with net income of $1.8 billion.

item.title: Peter Berg's football drama The Mosquito Bowl premieres on Netflix
item.description: The Mosquito Bowl, a football drama set after Pearl Harbor, premieres on Netflix on November 25.

item.title: Optimizely supply-chain attack put a card skimmer on 178 brands' sites
item.description: Malicious code in Optimizely's JavaScript ran on 178 brands' websites on November 16, skimming card data and swapping crypto addresses, reports say.

item.title: CAD images suggest the iPhone 18e will get an unusual new camera design
item.description: Leaked CAD images point to an unusual new camera design for Apple's next budget phone, the iPhone 18e, 9to5Mac reports.

item.title: PS Plus adds four more games, including Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza
item.description: PS Plus Extra and Premium added Cricket 26, Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii, MotoGP 26 and Trepang2 on November 24.

item.title: The Hunting Wives season 2 arrives on Netflix on Thanksgiving Day
item.description: All eight episodes of The Hunting Wives season 2, with Brittany Snow and Malin Akerman, stream on Netflix on November 26.

item.title: Valve sets 2027 Steam Fest dates, from desktop companions to rhythm games
item.description: Valve's 2027 Steam Fest calendar starts with a Desktop Companion Fest on January 14-18 and includes Couch Co-Op and Rhythm events.

item.title: Game Pass adds Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior, with Arkheron on day one
item.description: Xbox Game Pass adds Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 on November 24, and Arkheron launches in Game Preview on November 27.

item.title: Mastodon announce a spring 2027 UK and European tour
item.description: Mastodon's Poisonous Weapons Tour heads to the UK and Europe from March 14 in Paris, with Monolord supporting.
